facts.fact: La Nation reports that the tripartite agreement signed in Djibouti on 4 February 2026 by Djibouti Telecom, Ethio telecom and Sudatel covers construction and maintenance of a cross-border terrestrial fibre link joining Djibouti, Ethiopia and Sudan.

La Nation reports on 2026-09-09 that the three operators presented Horizon to hyperscalers and carriers in Addis Ababa on 2026-09-07, in a pre-commercialisation phase before deployment and commercial launch, describing it as a future infrastructure.

systems.owner: Djibouti Telecom, Ethio telecom and Sudatel Group
systems.tiers: operators; hyperscalers and carriers as prospective customers
